attributes.name: RHL 6U League 2020-2021
attributes.description:
PRIORITY REGISTRATION BEGINS NOVEMBER 1 @ 7PM!
RHL 2026-2027

RHL 6U, 2020-2021 birthyears WINTER 26-27 (December 2026 - February 2027)

Anticipated Season Start Date:
December 15, 2026

Note Important Registration Timeline:

November 1-9: RETURNING FALL 2026 RHL 6U PLAYER PRIORITY REGISTRATION

November 10: OPEN REGISTRATION.

ALL PLAYERS MUST REGISTER FOR THEIR BIRTH YEAR, NO EXCEPTIONS.

Registration begins at 7pm for each time period.

Online registration is required. In-person registration is not available.

RHL fills quickly, so PLEASE REGISTER EARLY. Once a level is full, a waitlist will be available. Ensure that you have your 2026-2027 USA Hockey number available during registration. You are encouraged to have your 2026-2027 USA Hockey number at least 24 hours in advance. Hint: the fourth digit will be a 7. membership.usahockey.com. If you previously provided your number for the Fall 6U registration, you shouldn't have to enter it again.

View all available program details https://www.medstarcapitalsiceplex.com/page/show/6321843-rooftop-hockey-league.



Refunds are not offered for RHL.

Questions about eligibility or enrollment? Contact Hockey@MedStarCapitalsIceplex.com

attributes.name: RHL 14U/16U League 2010-2013
attributes.description:
PRIORITY REGISTRATION BEGINS JULY 1 @ 7PM!
RHL 2026-2027

RHL 14U/16U, 2010-2013 birthyears

Anticipated Season Start Dates (to be confirmed later in the summer):
Week of Monday, September 14, 2026

Preseason Training camp and evaluation skate held in late August - details will be available in late July or early August.

Note Important Registration Timeline:

July 1 - 8th: RETURNING FALL/WINTER 2025-2026 RHL PLAYER PRIORITY REGISTRATION

July 9-15th: RETURNING RHL SPRING 2026 AND ELIGIBLE LTP PARTICIPANTS. (Must have completed at least 2 series of LTP at Medstar - or be enrolled in your second series of LTP at MedStar, or have participated in Spring 2026 or Previous RHL season.)

July 16th: OPEN REGISTRATION. Registrants must still meet the requirements of previous house league experience (at MedStar or other rink) or two LTP series experience (at MedStar or other rink. Future Caps is considered LTP.)

ALL PLAYERS/GOALIES MUST REGISTER FOR THEIR BIRTH YEAR, NO EXCEPTIONS.
Players and goalies use designated registration for 10U, 12U, and 14U/16U.
There are no designated goalies for 6U or 8U - all participants use the same registration for their age division.

Registration begins at 7pm for each time period.

Online registration is required. In-person registration is not available.

RHL fills quickly, so PLEASE REGISTER EARLY. Once a level is full, a waitlist will be available. Ensure that you have your 2026-2027 USA Hockey number available during registration. You are encouraged to have your 2026-2027 USA Hockey number at least 24 hours in advance. Hint: the fourth digit will be a 7. membership.usahockey.com.

View all available program details https://www.medstarcapitalsiceplex.com/page/show/6321843-rooftop-hockey-league.


Refunds are not offered for RHL.

Questions about eligibility or enrollment? Contact Hockey@MedStarCapitalsIceplex.com

attributes.name: Stick n Shoot
attributes.description:
Stick n Shoot is open to all ages and abilities.  Each participant that skates is required to purchase.  You can only add people in your account but you can share to your friends to invite them to join you!

  • Full Gear Is Required - This includes helmet, shoulder pads, elbow pads, gloves, pants, shin guards, protective cup, and hockey skates.
  • Helmets must be worn at all times while on the ice and while on the bench.
  • Face masks are required at all times.

attributes.name: Adult Swim
attributes.description:
Adult Swim

Sick of being on the ice with rowdy children? WE GOT YOU! Now introducing Adult Swim. If you’re 18+ and wanting to work on your hockey skills, figure skating elements, OR JUST WANT TO SKATE come on up.

Adult swim is geared toward the adult beginning skater that wants to work on their skills without the intimidation of experienced skaters whirling all around them. Lessons are permitted on Adult Swim. Cost $15.

attributes.name: RHL
attributes.description:
Rooftop Hockey League is for players 6U to 16U!

The mission of RHL is to provide a fun, competitive, and safe hockey environment which improves skills, develops self-confidence and respect for others, and fosters teamwork in our student athletes.

RHL is committed to the development of hockey players and teaching life skills through individual and team concepts, resulting in a lifelong enjoyment of hockey. Our program is desigend to provide the oppotunity to play for enjoyment and healthy competition.

You can view season details HERE.
